The claim states that in P-Frame Mode, codebooks are retrained from the previous frame. The evidence explicitly states: 'Secondly, codebooks can be retrained from the previous frame. Retraining proceeds by taking the previous codebooks as initial codebooks to the LBG algorithm.' It further clarifies that this method is used for frames other than key-frames (I-frames), which aligns with the concept of P-frames (predictive frames) in video compression terminology often used in this context.
